_comment: Free local run via Ollama (https://ollama.com). No API key needed.
_comment_setup: Install Ollama, then pull each model: ollama pull <name>

models.name: qwen3:8b
models._note: think=false disables chain-of-thought mode; without it each call takes 3-5 min

models.name: mistral:7b
models._note: EXCLUDED: does not emit structured tool_calls (writes prose pseudo-code); 0% utility. Replaced by mistral-nemo.

models.name: mistral-nemo
models._note: Tool-capable Mistral replacement for mistral:7b (12B, native function calling).

models.name: gemma2:9b
models._note: EXCLUDED: entire Gemma family (gemma2 AND gemma3, all sizes) returns HTTP 400 'does not support tools' from Ollama. Cannot run a tool-calling benchmark. Verified 2026-06-20 against gemma2:9b and gemma3:4b. ('gemma3:9b' was also a nonexistent tag.)

models.name: deepseek-r1:8b
models._note: think=false also needed for deepseek-r1 to suppress <think> traces
